docs.summary: Helpers for painting an [`IOrigamiIcon`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.IOrigamiIcon) into a Paper element.

members.name: Icon
members.signature: public static ElementBuilder Icon(this ElementBuilder box, Paper paper, IOrigamiIcon? icon, Color color, float stroke = 1.5f, float size = 0f)

docs.summary: Paint `icon` centered in this box after layout (no-op if null). When `size` is positive the glyph is drawn at that pixel size, centered; otherwise it fills the box.
